description: This file defines the FuelTunePane class, which is a GUI component for tuning fuel maps in an automotive ECU tuning application. It manages data collection, display, processing, and uploading of fuel maps, including functions for auto-tuning iterations, data logging, and table manipulation.

classes.name: FuelTunePane
classes.description: A GUI panel for auto-tuning fuel maps, handling data collection, visualization, processing, and uploading of fuel map data.

methods.name: uploadCurrentResult
methods.description: Uploads the modified fuel map to the controller and triggers a reload in the GUI.

methods.name: doClean
methods.description: Clears the incoming data points buffer.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data into a Table from the byte array content at a specified offset.

methods.name: doJob
methods.description: Performs a single auto-tuning iteration, updating maps and logging data.

methods.name: writeDataPoints
methods.description: Logs data points to the tuning log file.

methods.name: logMap
methods.description: Logs a map of values to the log file.

methods.name: getTuneLogStream
methods.description: Initializes and returns the DataOutputStream for logging.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D double array to a byte array suitable for transmission to the controller.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Sets up sensor listeners and loads current map data for display and collection.

methods.name: reloadVeTable
methods.description: Reloads the VE (voltage enhancer) table data from the controller content.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads a 2D map array from controller memory at a specified offset.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads a float array from the controller's byte buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main GUI component of this panel.
